text: In order to prevent the people from treating their parents with cruelty, the Emperor first sets an example to them by showing a dear love to his mother; and in order to teach them not to treat their parents with rudeness, he first treats his parents with respect.
author: Confucius and Zengzi
reference: The Classic of Filial Piety (Xiao Jing)
locator: Chapter II, The Filial Duty of an Emperor
